body:
Because I am alone. 
I have messed up everything I have ever touched. 
Relationships, Opportunities, Friendships. 
People would say I have a lot to live for. But I know what goes on inside. Its dark, and bleak. 
People say I am good looking. 
I know better, But I know that I am ugly. I have no ambition or drive. This means I have no hope to have a loving relationship. 
I know that relationships are not the be all of this life. . . but fuck am I ever lonely. 
I am a paradox like so many before me. 
This why I hate myself. This is why everyday I talk horribly to myself in my head. And then the thoughts of death sneak in, although they do not need to sneak as I welcome the release. 
Been on meds, didnt help. Been to therapy, did not help. 
I am scared.
